subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Investigates symmetry in nature using mirrors; completes an incomplete symmetrical picture on pegboards

show.line: Look at the butterfly. This side and that side are the same. That is symmetry!

rounds.prompt: Which butterfly is the same on both sides?
Look in the mirror. Which leaf is the same on both sides?
Look at the face. One eye each side. Is it the same on both sides? Say yes or no.
Half the butterfly is missing! Which wing finishes it so both sides match?
rounds.praise: Yes! Now both sides are the same.

rounds.prompt: Same on both sides, or not? Put each picture in its group.
Finish the flower. Which half makes both sides the same?

hints: Fold it in the middle. Do the two sides match?
Look at one side, then the other. Same or different?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will finish the butterfly.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I put a big wing here and a tiny wing there. Perfect!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The wings must match. Same on both sides.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A big wing here, so a big wing there. Now they match!

parent_line: Can see when a picture is the same on both sides.
